name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Basalt goes with exactly two of Cho, Luna, and 18 ly.
Either Dasari goes with Basalt or Luna goes with Fungus.
Rios' distance is lower than both the colonist from Europa and the colonist studying Basalt.
Either Europa goes with Fungus, or Luna goes with Lichen — but not both.

chain: Start by assuming Luna goes with Fungus.
Luna goes with Fungus, so it can't also go with Lichen.
Fungus goes with Luna, so Europa can't go with Fungus.
…but now the clue “Either Europa goes with Fungus, or Luna goes with Lichen — but not both” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Luna does not go with Fungus.
